# read_raspa_pdb_movie { #mofography.movies.read_raspa_pdb_movie }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> RASPA PDB parser; read_movie_snapshots with movie_format raspa_pdb covers this. Use `read_movie_snapshots` instead.

```python
movies.read_raspa_pdb_movie(
    path,
    max_frames=None,
    frame_stride=1,
    position_decimals=4,
)
```

Parse a RASPA PDB movie into canonical snapshot dictionaries.
